title: Breathtaking Aconitum
description: This mod adds aconite and its unique mechanics, food, and toxins
body:
# About:
This mod adds a new flower called Aconitum, also known as monkshood, wolfsbane, devil's helmet, or blue rocket. The mod adds food, a deadly neurotoxin, and a host of new mechanics!

![Replace this with a description](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/5d4571083ba3837c6ed546ae70286bcd2196d59c.png)
![Replace this with a description](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/6356aab2749c78e9318c05f06782af368e57bbba.png)
# Content:
## Items:
- What’s the point of the aconitum flower, which is used to make a decoction that mimics the effects of aconitine?
- A deadly neurotoxin that makes fighting mobs easier
- An amulet that provides temporary protection against the effects of a neurotoxin when activated
## World Generation:
Now, purple aconitum flowers are appearing near freshwater springs
# Additional things:
The mod has been fully translated into German, Spanish, and Russian. We plan to translate it into more languages, but this is only possible with your support!
